purpose: Test missing life-loss, mana and printed-cascade counterplay under explicit reproducible conditional board states, not win rates or full-deck paired comparisons.
hypotheses: Without haste, a newly cast Heartless Hidetsugu or Tree of Perdition cannot activate on entry turn; if a tap source fails to survive to a later untap, it adds no immediate X.
Heartless activation persists after its source is removed from battlefield; Tree exchange fails if Tree leaves before its ability resolves.
Even large life loss cannot grant Abaddon cascade if the commander is absent, the spell is not cast from hand during controller turn, or the follow-up colored-mana costs cannot be paid.
Bituminous Blast has one printed cascade independent of Abaddon and receives a second cascade if Abaddon's own-turn hand-cast threshold is at least its mana value five.
Replacing Bituminous Blast sacrifices an interaction mode and the printed cascade trigger even when an added tap threat produces a larger life-loss X.
Removing Kessig Flamebreather forfeits immediate on-cast 1-damage-per-opponent triggers; removing Birgi forfeits post-cast red mana (and Harnfel access), absent other effects.
controls: printed cascade of Bituminous Blast independent of commander
Birgi red mana delayed until after spell cast
commander absent, exile cast, enemy turn, X under mv
prevention/removal/haste scenarios verified against prior response grid
invariants: No randomized gameplay model or statistical confidence interval is produced
Numerical scenario results are conditional counterfactuals only; no additive benefit or upgrade ranking
No manual changes to accepted M5, historic Step C, canonical lists, registry, user locks, approvals or project exceptions
Any actual improvement claim requires separately pre-registered deckwide effect-aware paired evidence and formal independent Pass C
